d: Srimoti, a widow, suspects there is more to her husband's mysterious death. Thereafter, she hires a married lawyer, Jion, who eventually gets attracted to Srimoti, to investigate the matter.
After getting expelled from medical school, Siddhartha works at a sweet shop while taking care of his depressed mother. But, chaos ensues when he claims to have concocted a pill to cure depression.
Latika is forcefully married off after Bilash leaves the country. When he returns and finds that she has a family, he decides to avenge all the wrongs done to him.
A cab driver arrives at a police station with an ailing passenger who is found dead when an officer examines him and later, an investigation ensues revealing unsavory connections to the victim.
Shubhankar falls for Puja and manages to win her love after relentless pursuits. However, things take a complicated turn when Puja's brother decides to kill Shubhankar.
After Rajiv and Subhra marry, their new life faces turmoil. Subhra's former lover, Raja, returns with the intention of wrecking their lives, creating unexpected challenges for the couple.
Ajay, struggling in his life, finds his troubles worsening when he falls in love with Sangita, a woman from a wealthy family and a vastly different social background.
Two researchers and a doctor set out to find a mythical substance called red mercury to solve the fossil fuel crisis and save a child's life.
Jatindranath Mukherjee plays a central role in the revolutionary struggle against colonial rule. He is revered for his leadership and dedication in India's quest for freedom.
Byomkesh Bakshi, a detective, is hired to find the arms left by the American soldiers after World War II. However, his search leads to the discovery of a bigger conspiracy.
Finding solace in magic, Indra keeps his problems at bay. However, his life takes a turn when he meets Kirti and their connection unveils a past life story.
